If the auditor returns feedback, here’s how we will respond efficiently:

| Feedback Type | Response Strategy | Tools / Artifacts |
|---------------|-------------------|-------------------|
| SLO Alert Logic Invalid | Re-validate Prometheus query using synthetic load test data | `test/slo-validation-test.py`, `prometheus/query-simulator.json` |

| Logging Missing Correlation ID | Inject `X-Correlation-ID` at ingress via Istio `EnvoyFilter` | `ingress/correlation-id-inject.yaml` |
| Backup Policy Non-Compliant | Confirm Velero encryption & retention match policy | `velero/policies/daily-backup.yaml`, `velero/backup-status-check.sh` |

> ⚠️ **No changes made unless explicitly requested** — current configuration is compliant and locked.
